categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and modifies `src/test/transaction_tests.cpp` to extend test helpers and add consensus input validation coverage.
categories.rationale: Extends unit test helpers to cover multi-input transactions in `Consensus::CheckTxInputs`, closing a coverage gap in consensus money range checks. The PR notes that existing tests only checked single inputs where `coin.out.nValue` equaled `nValueIn`, allowing mutation tests (such as changing `||` to `&&`) to pass undetected. Adding coverage to high-risk consensus code paths provides solid value, though it is reasonably deferrable.
